proposals.before: The Documents says: 'Only first advance the king to correct his affairs.'
proposals.after: The Documents says: 'It is the former kings who rectified their affairs.'
proposals.reason: The Shangshu quotation 惟先假王正厥事 means the former (sage) kings corrected their affairs; 'Only first advance the king' mistranslates 假/格 and obscures the sense.

proposals.before: Granted maternal uncle Wang Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi the noble rank of Guannei Marquis.
proposals.after: Granted his maternal uncles Wang Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi the noble rank of Marquis Within the Passes.
proposals.reason: Five men are granted the rank, so 'uncle' must be plural; also align 'Guannei Marquis' with the established rendering 'Marquis Within the Passes' used in s0015.

proposals.before: Established former Hejian King younger brother Shangjun storehouse official Liang as king.
proposals.after: Established the former King of Hejian's younger brother, Liang the Shangjun storehouse official, as king.
proposals.reason: The literal English is telegraphic and fuses titles; a minimally corrected literal should keep the kinship and office readable.

proposals.before: In the sixth month of summer, maternal uncle Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi were all enfeoffed as marquises.
proposals.after: In the sixth month of summer, maternal uncles Tan, Shang, Li, Gen, and Fengshi were all enfeoffed as marquises.
proposals.reason: Chinese 舅譚、商、立、根、逢時 names five maternal uncles; singular 'uncle' misreads the plural series.

proposals.before: An edict declared: 'I have obtained to protect the ancestral temples, fearful and trembling, not able to live up to the title.
proposals.after: An edict declared: 'I have been entrusted with protecting the ancestral temples, fearful and trembling, not able to live up to the title.
proposals.reason: 'I have obtained to protect' is unnatural English that obscures 獲保宗廟 as holding the duty of temple protection.

proposals.before: In the second month, the Chanyu was dismissed and returned to his country.
proposals.after: In the second month, the Chanyu concluded his visit and returned to his country.
proposals.reason: 罷歸國 after a court audience means the visit ended and he went home, not dismissal from office.

proposals.before: Edict said: 'Formerly at Emperor Yao established Xi, He officials, commanded with four seasons affairs, caused not lose their order.
proposals.after: Edict said: 'Formerly Emperor Yao established the Xi and He officials, commanded them with the affairs of the four seasons, and caused them not to lose their order.
proposals.reason: Literal English is ungrammatical ('Formerly at Emperor Yao established') and omits clear object marking present in the Chinese.

proposals.before: The Former Emperor promoted agriculture, thinned their rents and taxes, favored their strong strength, and caused them to be in the same category as filial younger brothers.
proposals.after: The Former Emperor promoted agriculture, lightened their rents and taxes, favored the able-bodied and industrious, and placed them in the same category as those practiced in filial piety and fraternal duty.
proposals.reason: 孝弟 here is the ethical pair filial piety and brotherly duty (孝悌), not 'filial younger brothers'; 'favored their strong strength' is unnatural for 寵其彊力.

proposals.before: Former Emperor promoted agriculture, thinned their rents taxes, favored their strong strength, caused with filial younger brothers same category.
proposals.after: Former Emperor promoted agriculture, thinned their rents and taxes, favored their strong labor, caused them to be in the same category with filial piety and fraternal duty.
proposals.reason: Same 孝弟 mistranslation as in the idiomatic field; literal English is also missing conjunctions.

proposals.before: In autumn, there was great flooding east of the pass, and floating people who wished to enter the Hangu, Tianjing, Hukou, and Wuran passes should not be harshly detained.
proposals.after: In autumn, there was great flooding east of the pass, and floating people who wished to enter the Hangu, Tianjing, Hukou, and Wuyan passes should not be harshly detained.
proposals.reason: 五阮關 is standardly Wuyan Pass; 'Wuran' is a romanization error.

proposals.before: In ten days it was pacified, Hu was moved to Commander of the Guards, and granted 100 catties of gold.
proposals.after: Within about a month it was pacified; Hu was moved to Commander of the Guards and granted 100 catties of gold.
proposals.reason: Chinese 旬月 means roughly a month (across ten-day periods), not literally ten days.

proposals.before: Ten days months pacified, moved Hu to Commander of the Guards, granted gold 100 catties.
proposals.after: Ten-day periods / a month pacified; moved Hu to Commander of the Guards; granted gold 100 catties.
proposals.reason: Literal rendering 'Ten days months' obscures 旬月; render as ten-day periods or a month.

proposals.before: Wannian was flattering and evil, not loyal, poison flowed to the multitude of common people, within the seas they resented and hoped, until now has not ceased. Though he received the pardon order, it is not proper for him to dwell in the capital.
proposals.after: Wannian was flattering and evil, not loyal; poison flowed to the multitude of common people; within the seas they harbored resentment, which has not ceased to this day. Though he received the pardon order, it is not proper for him to dwell in the capital.
proposals.reason: 怨望 means resentful grievance, not 'resented and hoped'.

proposals.before: In the twelfth month, Shanyang iron official convicts Su Ling and 227 others attacked and killed chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, called themselves generals, experienced nineteen commanderies and kingdoms, and killed the Dongjun Governor and Runan Commandant.
proposals.after: In the twelfth month, Shanyang iron official convicts Su Ling and 227 others attacked and killed chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, called themselves generals, passed through nineteen commanderies and kingdoms, and killed the Dongjun Governor and Runan Commandant.
proposals.reason: 經歷 means traversed/passed through; 'experienced' is a calque that obscures the military movement.

proposals.before: Send out the various ones from Duling who have not yet been favored to return home.
proposals.after: Sent out the various ones from Duling who had not yet been favored to return home.
proposals.reason: Chronicle narrative should be past tense; present 'Send out' mismatches the annals voice.

proposals.before: Officials and people admire and emulate, mutually thus becoming custom, and desiring the common people to be frugal and moderate, with families providing and persons sufficient—how is this not difficult!
proposals.after: Officials and people admire and emulate, gradually thus becoming custom, and desiring the common people to be frugal and moderate, with families providing and persons sufficient—how is this not difficult!
proposals.reason: 'Mutually' poorly renders the progressive custom-forming sense and obscures the edict's point about spreading extravagance.

proposals.before: Lodged at Ceiyang palace and granted the attendant officials.
proposals.after: Lodged at Fuyang palace and granted the attendant officials.
proposals.reason: 萯陽 is Fuyang; 'Ceiyang' is a corrupted transliteration.

proposals.before: Lodged Ceiyang palace, granted attendant officials.
proposals.after: Lodged Fuyang palace, granted attendant officials.
proposals.reason: Same 萯陽 to Fuyang correction required in the literal English.

proposals.before: Formerly Cheng Tang received the mandate, was ranked as the three generations, and the sacrifices were abolished and extinguished.
proposals.after: Formerly Cheng Tang received the mandate, was ranked among the Three Dynasties, and the sacrifices were abolished and extinguished.
proposals.reason: 列为三代 means ranked among the Three Dynasties, not 'as the three generations'.

proposals.before: Praise says: The minister's paternal aunt filled the rear palace as a Lady, and father, sons, and brothers served the curtains and canopy. Frequently spoke to the minister saying that Emperor Cheng was good at cultivating his appearance and conduct—ascending the chariot he stood upright, not looking back inward, not speaking rapidly, not pointing personally, facing court in deep silence, dignified like a god—can truly be called the solemn and solemn appearance of the Son of Heaven!
proposals.after: Praise says: The minister's paternal aunt filled the rear palace as a Lady, and father, sons, and brothers served the curtains and canopy. Frequently spoke to the minister saying that Emperor Cheng was good at cultivating his appearance and conduct—ascending the chariot he stood upright, not looking back inward, not speaking rapidly, not pointing personally, facing court in deep silence, dignified like a god—can truly be called the august appearance of the Son of Heaven!
proposals.reason: 穆穆天子之容 is the august demeanor of the Son of Heaven; 'solemn and solemn' is an unnatural duplication.

proposals.before: Since Jianshi, the Wang clan began to grasp the state's fate. Ai and Ping had short blessings, Mang then usurped the position—indeed his power and blessing came gradually!
proposals.after: Since Jianshi, the Wang clan began to grasp the state's fate. Ai and Ping had short reigns, Mang then usurped the throne—indeed the source of his power and fortune was gradual!
proposals.reason: 短祚 means short reigns, not 'short blessings'; 篡位 is usurping the throne.

decisions.reason: 惟先假王正厥事 is the Shangshu line on former/sage kings correcting their affairs; 'Only first advance the king' mistranslates 假/格.
賜舅王譚、商、立、根、逢時 names five maternal uncles; singular 'uncle' is wrong, and 關內侯 matches 'Marquis Within the Passes'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 賜舅王譚、商、立、根、逢時爵關內侯

decisions.reason: The telegraphic literal already encodes 故河間王弟上郡庫令良為王 without semantic error; the rewrite only restyles the literal register.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 立故河間王弟上郡庫令良為王

decisions.reason: 封舅譚、商、立、根、逢時皆為列侯 lists five men under 舅; singular 'maternal uncle' misreads the plural series.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 封舅譚、商、立、根、逢時皆為列侯

decisions.reason: 朕獲保宗廟 means holding the charge of protecting the ancestral temples; 'I have obtained to protect' is ungrammatical and obscures that sense.
After 單于來朝, 罷歸國 means the visit ended and he returned home, not that the Chanyu was dismissed from office.
昔在帝堯立羲、和之官 is grammatical Chinese; 'Formerly at Emperor Yao established' is broken English and drops the clear objects of 命/令.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 昔在帝堯立羲、和之官，命以四時之事，令不失其序

decisions.reason: 令與孝弟同科 uses 孝弟 as the ethical pair filial piety and fraternal duty, not 'filial younger brothers'; 寵其彊力 favors the able and industrious.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 寵其彊力，令與孝弟同科

decisions.reason: The same 孝弟 ethical pair is mistranslated in the literal as 'filial younger brothers'; the repair restores that sense and readable conjunctions.
五阮關 is the pass name read Wuyan (阮 as yuán in this toponym); 'Wuran' is an erroneous romanization.
旬月平 means pacified within about a month across ten-day periods, not in literally ten days.
Literal 'Ten days months' garbles 旬月; rendering it as ten-day periods or a month correctly reflects the compound.
海內怨望 means the empire harbored resentful grievance; 'resented and hoped' invents a false second sense for 望.
經歷郡國十九 means they passed through nineteen commanderies and kingdoms; 'experienced' is a misleading calque.
出杜陵諸未嘗御者歸家 is narrative annals prose and should be past tense; present 'Send out' mismatches the chronicle voice.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 出杜陵諸未嘗御者歸家

decisions.reason: 浸以成俗 means the emulation gradually becomes custom; 'mutually' does not render 浸.

decisions.after: Lodged at Beiyang palace and granted the attendant officials.
decisions.reason: Ceiyang is a corrupt reading of 萯陽; Yan Shigu cites 萯音倍, so Beiyang is the commentary-backed romanization rather than Fuyang.

decisions.after: Lodged Beiyang palace, granted attendant officials.
decisions.reason: The literal likewise needs 萯陽 as Beiyang (萯音倍), not the corrupted Ceiyang or the weaker Fuyang alternative.
列為三代 means Cheng Tang was ranked among the Three Dynasties, not 'ranked as the three generations'.
穆穆天子之容 is the august demeanor of the Son of Heaven; duplicating 'solemn and solemn' is an unnatural calque of the reduplication.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 可謂穆穆天子之容者矣

decisions.reason: 哀、平短祚 means Ai and Ping had short reigns, and 莽遂篡位 is Mang usurping the throne; 'short blessings' and bare 'position' misread both phrases.

value.assessment: good at cultivating appearance and deportment; solemn Son of Heaven demeanor
good at cultivating appearance and deportment; august Son of Heaven demeanor

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted repair restores 穆穆 as august; the extracted assessment's 'solemn Son of Heaven demeanor' was produced by the duplicated solemn calque.
